user.title: Connect to MHUB
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your MHUB device.

confirm.title: MHUB Connected
confirm.description:
Successfully connected to **{mhub_name}**.

The integration will be added with all controls enabled by default.

Click ⚙️ **Configure** after setup to choose control methods per zone and filter which commands are exposed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MHUB. Check the IP address and that the device is online.
error.timeout_connect: Connection timed out. Check the IP address and network.
error.invalid_host: Invalid IP address or hostname format.

abort.already_configured: This MHUB device is already configured.

init.title: Zone Control Methods
init.description:
Choose the control method for each zone:

{zone_list}

Use IR if a uControl pack is assigned to that output port. Use CEC for HDMI-CEC control. Use None to disable control entities.

After saving, reload the integration to apply changes.

zone_commands.title: Select Commands — {zone_label}
zone_commands.description: Choose which {method} commands to expose as buttons for {zone_label}. Deselect commands you don't need. {command_count} commands available.
